summary: HeartSciences Inc. (Parent) entered a merger agreement to acquire Fortitude Mining HoldCo (a Zcash mining platform) from its sole owner Digital Currency Group via its merger subsidiary Cordis Acquisition. Consideration is 100% stock: Parent will issue Class V common stock (one vote per share, no economic rights) while existing stock becomes Class A (economic with votes). The deal lacks explicit per-share price, premium, or value terms in the excerpt. The Parent board seeks stockholder approval for charter amendments. Operational focus shifts to digital-asset mining. Watch regulatory clearance and shareholder vote timing; risk-arb centers on valuation uncertainty and approval risk.
